result.contract: FP32 master params/normalization/activation/loss/AdamW; GEMM input rounding to FP16, FP32 accumulation/output and explicit straight-through backward. No dropout. Mask uses finite -1e4. Fixed resident data; no KV cache.
result.scope: Native-routed experiments, not automatic whole-program compilation. oa_tensor_only shares Torch pointwise/reductions; oa_legacy/direct use native operators when present. Embedding/masks/loss/bias/affine/packing/clipping/optimizer are shared CUDA; cuda_library uses matched GemmEx and shared Torch operations. No Inductor attribution.
result.timing: Paired shuffled steady updates include zeroing, casts/transposes, saved activations, forward/backward/clipping/AdamW and host enqueue gaps; data loading/initial compilation excluded. Stage spans nest and are nonadditive. Inference graph capture separately poisoned and checked.
